findings.issue: The module docstring and the docstrings of `fourier_eval_add` (l.31), `fourier_eval_sub` (l.36), `norm_fourier_eval` (l.43), `integrable_fourier_comp` (l.49) and `integrable_fourier_mul_conj_fourier` (l.56) write the monomial as `e^{i n x}` although `T` is an arbitrary real; Mathlib defines `fourier n x = exp (2 π i n x / T)`, so that reading is correct only for `T = 2π`. The file states no such hypothesis, and the vague 'with the normalisation of the bundled additive character `TauCeti.fourierAddChar`' does not fix the exponent (`fourierAddChar_apply` shows it is pointwise equal to `fourier n`).
